title: Text and diffusion share one skeleton
alt: Two parallel chains. Text grows one token per step, each chosen by a categorical lookup with its own uniform input. A noisy grid becomes a clean pattern through Gaussian updates. Both are labeled Y = F(X, U).
caption: Different states, same skeleton: deterministic updates driven by independent noise.
data_source: Conceptual diagram. Token example (mat/sofa/roof, u=0.63 picks sofa) from the post. Noise grids are pseudorandom (TikZ rnd, seeded with the metadata seed) blended with a Gaussian blob, drawn as halftone dots; they are illustrative, not model outputs.
